title: Subturtle starter pack
description: Beginner (A1) survival chunks for one learning language. Served by the language module's get-starter-pack function: each item's translation is picked from `translations` by the learner's own language.

language.description: The learning language of every item's text.

version.description: Raised whenever items are added, removed or reworded.

groups.description: Display order of the groups. Every item's group must be listed here.

name.description: English label; clients localize by id.

id.description: <language>-<group>-<nn>. The <group>-<nn> part names the same concept in every pack, so packs can be compared. Never reuse an id for a different chunk.

text.description: The chunk in the learning language, as a learner would hear it in a video.

lemma.description: Dictionary form of the cloze target word.

form.description: The cloze target exactly as it appears in `text` (blanked on a cloze card).

translations.description: Meaning in each checked own language, except the item's own language.

note.description: Short English usage hint (formality, gender variant, when to say it).
